data.title: 间桐樱 · 图书室窗边
data.description: 【间桐樱 · 图书室窗边】午后放学后的图书室角落，樱安静地倚靠在窗边的长桌旁翻看着花卉种植图册，金色光尘在她的紫发间缓缓跳跃。察觉到你在对面坐下，她将食指轻轻按在唇上——「嘘……图书室要保持安静哦。不过能和学长坐在一起看书，真的好开心。」
data.action: 倚在窗边长桌旁，将花卉种植图册摊在桌上，一手压页另一手食指抵唇提醒安静
data.promptProse: Sakura leans lightly against the school-library table, one hand keeping a flower-growing album flat while the other index finger touches her lips in a quiet reminder. Violet eyes brighten above her smile, beige blazer and red bow neatly arranged. The medium portrait includes the illustrated page and shelves receding beyond the window. Afternoon light reaches her hair ribbon and album, leaving the table's underside and book gaps in soft shadow.
